tokens.name: bg-window
tokens.usage: The void: page background behind every tab, and the ground the grid texture is drawn on.

tokens.name: bg-content
tokens.usage: Content surfaces: the downloads, history and messages tables, settings panels and cards.

tokens.name: bg-elevated
tokens.usage: Sheets (dialogs), and the opaque fallback for menus and glass when backdrop blur or transparency is unavailable.

tokens.name: bg-glass
tokens.usage: Glass material for chrome only: toolbar, settings sidebar, menus and floating notices. Always paired with backdrop-filter: blur(var(--blur-glass)) saturate(180%).

tokens.name: fill-primary
tokens.usage: Off track of a switch, the selected segment in dark, pressed default button.

tokens.name: fill-secondary
tokens.usage: Segmented control track, hovered default button, count badge fill.

tokens.name: fill-tertiary
tokens.usage: Default button and text field fill, progress track, status label ground when neutral.

tokens.name: fill-quaternary
tokens.usage: Hover on rows, menu items and plain buttons; alternate table rows; the faint glass of cards inside sheets.

tokens.name: label-primary
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on every bg-* surface, on any fill-*, on bg-glass and on accent-soft.

tokens.name: label-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text (sizes, ETAs, help text, column headers, placeholders) on every bg-* surface, any fill-*, bg-glass and accent-soft. Holds 4.5:1 on all of them.

tokens.name: label-tertiary
tokens.usage: Disabled text and decorative glyphs only. Below 4.5:1 on purpose; never for text a person must read.

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: Hairlines: row dividers, card and button edges, menu dividers, the toolbar's edge. Decorative: never the only boundary of a control a person must find.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Drafting lines: the frame and caption bar of a figure, the ruled page margins, the dots of the dot texture. Stronger than separator, still decorative.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Outline of controls whose edge must be seen: unchecked checkbox and radio, outlined text field, switch off. At least 3:1 on bg-window, bg-content and bg-elevated.

tokens.name: grid-line
tokens.usage: Lines of the measured-grid texture (.ng-grid-bg) on bg-window: login, empty states, the Statistics header. Decorative only.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Signal orange for text and icons: links, eyebrow labels, statistics figures, active plain buttons, selected sidebar icon, checks in menus. 4.5:1 on every bg-* surface, any fill-*, bg-glass and accent-soft.

tokens.name: accent-fill
tokens.usage: Solid orange of the primary button, a switch that is on, a checked checkbox, the active count badge, the highlighted menu item. Text on it is on-accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on accent-fill (4.6:1).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected table row, selected sidebar item, outline button hover. Text on it stays label-primary or accent.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Solid 2px keyboard focus ring, offset 2px, on every control. At least 3:1 on every bg-* surface and bg-glass.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Rust orange, the colour of the toothed ring in the NZBGet mark. Large identity blocks, splash and about screens, the cover; never text, never a status, never a button (buttons use accent-fill).

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Downloading and success marks: progress bar fill, status dot, success icon, finished cells in a segment map. At least 3:1 on bg-content and on the fill-tertiary progress track.

tokens.name: green-text
tokens.usage: Green text: DOWNLOADING, SUCCESS and post-processing status labels, on green-soft, bg-content and bg-elevated.

tokens.name: green-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground of green status labels and success alerts.

tokens.name: yellow
tokens.usage: Paused and warning marks: progress bar fill when paused, warning dot and icon. Kept yellow so it never reads as the orange accent. At least 3:1 on bg-content and the progress track.

tokens.name: yellow-text
tokens.usage: Yellow text: PAUSED and warning status labels, on yellow-soft, bg-content and bg-elevated.

tokens.name: yellow-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground of yellow status labels and warning alerts.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Error and failure marks: FAILURE dot, error icon, a failed health bar, missing cells in a segment map. At least 3:1 on bg-content and the progress track.

tokens.name: red-text
tokens.usage: Red text: FAILURE and error labels, inline error messages, the destructive button and destructive menu items, on red-soft, bg-content and bg-elevated.

tokens.name: red-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground of red status labels, error alerts and the destructive button.

tokens.name: cyan
tokens.usage: Information marks: LIVE REPAIR dot, info icon. The second accent, used sparingly. At least 3:1 on bg-content and the progress track.

tokens.name: cyan-text
tokens.usage: Cyan text: LIVE REPAIR and informational labels, on cyan-soft, bg-content and bg-elevated.

tokens.name: cyan-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground of cyan status labels and info alerts.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims the page behind an open sheet.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Inter", "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif
families.mono: "Azeret Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: speed
styles.usage: The live download speed in the Statistics header. Mono, light weight, pulled tight like a drawing's dimension.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Figures in stat tiles, set in accent over a micro label.

styles.name: large-title
styles.usage: One per page: the page or settings section title, under its eyebrow.

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Settings group headings and section titles inside long pages.

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: Sheet titles, which are usually nzb-file names; mono keeps dots and digits honest.

styles.name: title-3
styles.usage: Card and panel headings, sub-sections inside a sheet.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Emphasised body text: nzb-file names in tables, form labels.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default text everywhere: table cells, help text, menu items.

styles.name: callout
styles.usage: Secondary lines under a name, help text under a setting.

styles.name: footnote
styles.usage: Timestamps and footers in running text.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Section marker above a page title, uppercase, in accent, written '# Name' with its index after it.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Every button and tab label, uppercase.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Status labels, table column headers, sidebar sections, menu headers; uppercase.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Figure captions, stat labels, progress figures, rail labels and other measurements; uppercase.

styles.name: kbd
styles.usage: Keyboard shortcut chips inside tabs, menus and tooltips.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Messages log, script output, file paths in settings.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, gap between a status dot and its word.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons in a group, inner padding of glass bars around controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell horizontal padding, field horizontal padding, gap between toolbar clusters.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and panel padding, gap between form rows.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Window margin: distance from the page edge to tables and panels; sheet padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between settings sections and between stacked panels.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top margin of a page header (eyebrow and large-title).

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Status labels, keyboard chips, checkbox, segments inside a segmented control, cells of a segment map.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, text fields, selects, segmented track, menu and sidebar items, pagination.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers, inline alerts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Tables, cards, stat tiles and settings panels; wells inside a sheet.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Sheets, the floating toolbar and the settings sidebar.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Capsules only where the shape carries meaning: progress bars, switches, count badges, the search field, floating notices.

tokens.name: shadow-control
tokens.usage: Raised controls: the selected segment, switch knob.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Glass chrome: toolbar, sidebar, floating notices. A hairline edge plus a specular top line.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Tables, cards and settings panels on bg-window: an edge, not a lift.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Sheets (every modal dialog).

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: The orange glow on a hovered or focused primary button, and on nothing else.

tokens.name: size-control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons and segmented controls inside table toolbars and sheets.

tokens.name: size-control-md
tokens.usage: Default height of buttons, fields, selects and segmented controls.

tokens.name: size-control-lg
tokens.usage: Toolbar controls and primary actions on phones.

tokens.name: size-row
tokens.usage: Minimum table row height (downloads, history, messages).

tokens.name: size-toolbar
tokens.usage: Height of the floating glass toolbar.

tokens.name: size-sidebar
tokens.usage: Width of the settings sidebar on desktop.

tokens.name: size-grid
tokens.usage: Pitch of the line-grid texture (.ng-grid-bg). The dot texture (.ng-dots-bg) uses a quarter of it.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur radius for bg-glass chrome: backdrop-filter: blur(var(--blur-glass)) saturate(180%).

tokens.name: blur-menu
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur for menus and popovers, which sit over busier content.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls: the whole control, label and all.
